LESSON: POLITICAL DEVELOPMENT IN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Development and Governance
Topic 5.1: Political Development in Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Political Development in Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Political Development in Africa
2. Practise Political Development in Africa at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Political Development in Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Political Development in Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Political Development in Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Political Development in Africa at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Political Development in Africa at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Political Development in Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Political Development in Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Political Development in Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Political Development in Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Political Development in Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Political Development in Africa.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Political Development in Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Political Development in Africa important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Political Development in Africa
2. Practise Political Development in Africa at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Political Development in Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
